description: This file defines a PHP class 'ProjectViewTemplatesEdit' that extends 'ViewEdit' and manages displaying and handling project template editing views within the SuiteCRM application. It includes methods for rendering the module title parameters and setting a template flag before displaying the view.

classes.name: ProjectViewTemplatesEdit
classes.description: A view class for editing project templates, extending the generic ViewEdit class, customizing module title rendering and setting template-specific parameters.

methods.name: _getModuleTitleParams
methods.description: Generates the module title breadcrumbs for display, including a link to the specific project record if it exists.

methods.name: display
methods.description: Sets the 'is_template' flag on the bean and assigns it to the view before invoking the parent display method.
